name: Korean tiled roof assembly (KR-EAVE-01 + KR-ROOF-01 + KR-RIDGE-01)
owner_rule: 2026-10-09: the roof bottom should always be baked together with the field - possibly also the ridges
usage: bake recipe key "assembly": path to this file; the blender-high-low-baking assembly gate (assembly_scope.py) refuses any roof scope that leaves a part out

field.source: tile HIGH with the set reference section and downhill laps (TC roof_v2 course function, measured against the TC HIGH)

front.source: front HIGH: TC/military eave_recipe relief (round disc + rim + scalloped pan) on the actual receiver faces, on the field's roll rows

underlip.source: the front HIGH (no relief there); alpha = the front's alpha at the underlip's ACTUAL height (KR-EAVE-01 step 7)

caps.source: cap HIGH: TC ridge_v2 cap tiles (courses by arc length from the top, lip step, bead, eave upturn) + round end-tile disc

soffit.reason: no modelled relief on the soffit band; it must sit behind the cutout clearance and takes the assembly AO pass

main_ridge_timber.reason: KR-RIDGE-01: the main ridge is timber - grain along its length in the colour pass, assembly AO; no tile HIGH

built_up_ridge.reason: built-up plaster ridge: colour pass + assembly AO until a ridge HIGH is authored (declare it in the review)

gable.reason: vertical gable boards (KR-MAT-DIRECTION-01): colour pass + assembly AO

hidden_backing.reason: never visible; shared generic atlas cell
